sloka: ततो ऽभिषिक्तं शत्रुघ्नमङ्कमारोप्य राघवः ।उवाच मधुरां वाणीं तेजस्तस्याभिपूरयन् ।। ७.६३.१८ ॥
transliteration: tato 'bhiṣiktaṁ śatrughnamaṅkamāropya rāghavaḥ ।uvāca madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ tejastasyābhipūrayan ।। 7.63.18 ॥

translations.english: Then, Rama, having placed the consecrated Shatrughna on his lap, spoke sweet words, thereby enhancing his splendor and might.
